faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.a1: Hyperliquid Market Prices are reference prices from the Hyperliquid market. They are not official stock exchange prices and may differ significantly from traditional exchange prices.
faq.q2: Is NightTicker showing official stock exchange prices?
faq.a2: No. NightTicker displays Hyperliquid Market Prices for reference purposes only. These are not official stock exchange prices.
faq.q3: Why can Hyperliquid prices differ from stock exchange prices?
faq.a3: Hyperliquid operates independently from traditional stock exchanges. Prices reflect market activity on the Hyperliquid platform and may differ due to various factors including liquidity, timing, and market conditions.
faq.q4: Should I use NightTicker prices for investment decisions?
faq.a4: No. NightTicker provides reference information only. Do not rely on this information for investment or trading decisions. Always consult official sources and financial advisors.
faq.a5: Night Price refers to the current Hyperliquid Market Price when traditional stock exchanges are closed, such as overnight, weekends, or holidays. It is a reference price only.
faq.q6: Where can I view detailed charts?
faq.a6: For detailed charts, historical data, and advanced market information, please visit Hyperliquid directly.
